profile.title: Two-factor login
profile.intro: In addition to your password, the login asks for a code from your authenticator app. Strongly recommended for all users.
profile.step1: Open your authenticator app and choose "Add account".
profile.step3: Enter the code shown and confirm.
profile.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key manually:
profile.recoveryText: Each code works once if the app is not available. Write them down now – they are not shown again.
